patch_description: Replace the messy soft-objective machinery with a clean squared-distance log-sum-exp surrogate and its exact analytic Jacobian, use a finer sharpening schedule (p = 2→8→32→128), add more diverse structured starts, and finish with the exact-ratio polish. This reproduces the Gen-12/15 score (~1.00) in seconds instead of the 71s numerical-gradient version, while the finer anneal and extra starts (rings with varying parameters, jittered poles) increase the chance of beating the reference ratio slightly.
